_comment: Fictional dates for the lab, the one program-dates file Chapters 03 and 06 both read. In a real run the identity engineering lead copies them from the program master schedule: D08 (end dates for legacy authentication and NTLM) bounds an account kept on Kerberos (N3.6); G5 (AD retired) bounds every account kept in Active Directory (N7.3); D11 is the provisional target end state set at G0 (AdRetired, or KerberosIsland with an end-of-life date), which Chapter 06 reconciles every gMSA and dMSA against. Chapter 06 refuses a copy whose SHA-256 isn't the one Chapter 03's run recorded.
